title: shadPS4 0.12.5: official stable release
summary: shadPS4 published 0.12.5 on November 7, 2025. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation 4 emulator project.

blocks.text: The shadPS4 project published version 0.12.5 on November 7, 2025. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official release description states: Some would say, "why a new release this early"? While releases came every 2-3 months before, the previous 0.12.0 release had an input change, which made multiple games unplayable, so we needed to patch it quite early. With that, some other interesting features and bugfixes came from development continuing as before, so enjoy.
